Fix UAF issues in `gevents.c`

There are use-after-free issues in interactive graphics devices like `x11()`
and `windows()` when devices are destroyed while the handler is running e.g. by
`dev.off()` inside the handler or (on Windows) by a click on the window's close
button while the handler is running.

Here are reproducible examples using the former of calling `dev.off()` within
the handler:

```
dev_open <- function() {
    if (identical(.Platform$OS.type, "unix"))
        x11(type = "Xlib")
    else
        windows()
    plot.new()
}
idle_uaf <- function() {
    dev_open()
    getGraphicsEvent(
        onIdle = function() {
            dev.off()
        }
    )
}
mouse_uaf <- function() {
    dev_open()
    title("Click anywhere to trigger")
    getGraphicsEvent(
        onMouseDown = function(buttons, x, y) {
            dev.off()
        }
    )
}
keybd_uaf <- function() {
    dev_open()
    title("Press any key to trigger")
    getGraphicsEvent(
        onKeybd = function(key) {
            dev.off()
        }
    )
}
```

Before applying the attached patch running `mouse_uaf()` and then clicking
within in the device immediately leads to a segfault on my Linux machine using
`x11()`.  If you build R with `-fsanitize=address` then `idle_uaf()` and
`keybd_uaf()` also leads to immediate crashes otherwise the bug shows up as
silent heap corruption rather than an instant crash.
